description: Read live state from the running game. With 'properties' returns those values (supports 'position:x'); without, returns the node's class, children and common properties plus script variables. It only reads properties: to call a method use game_call.

node.description: Node in the running game: relative to the running scene (e.g. 'Player') or absolute (e.g. '/root/Main/Player'). Default: the running scene root.

name: game_query
title: Query running game
